_: Editorial policy for newsroom automation. scripts/lib/newsroom/policy.mjs is the only reader; scripts/verify-newsroom-automation.mjs gates its invariants. Phase 1: this file DECIDES, nothing ACTS on it yet.

autonomousPublishing._: Phase 1 leaves live publication under human editorial control. Flipping this to true is a separate, deliberate decision and does not by itself bypass any rule below.

highRiskCategories._: Always human-reviewed, regardless of evidence quality or confidence. Matched against the article's category, kicker and keywords.

evidence._minIndependentSources: Matches the existing editorial gate in verify-editorial-production.mjs. Two AI outputs agreeing is ONE source, not two: independence is counted by publisher, not by document.
evidence._requirePrimaryRecord: At least one source must be a primary record -- statute, decision, agency release, dataset, filing, or the original post as it circulated -- not another outlet's write-up.
evidence._conflictAction: When sources materially disagree, hold. Never average them, never pick the more quotable one.

imageRights._: Automation may propose a photograph but may never clear one. Clearance stays in content/news/rights-cleared-image-overrides.json with creator, licence, source page, caption and alt. A Creative Commons search filter is a lead, not a clearance. A fallback plate is not a photograph and never counts as coverage.
forbidden: an image-search result as proof of licence
scraping images from a source article
treating fallback artwork as evidence of coverage
dropping a caption or credit to fit a layout

attribution.aiDisclosure: FMB News uses automated assistance in monitoring, drafting and production. Every published report is attributable to evidence and is reviewed before publication.
attribution.syntheticAudioDisclosure: This narration is synthetic speech generated from the published FMB News report.

sponsorship._: A sponsor may buy placement. A sponsor may not influence a newsroom conclusion, a rating, a correction, or the decision to publish. Commercial state is stored separately from editorial judgement and is never an input to it.
